Subject: Forward-looking coverage scan and commit notice

Sarah / Acme finance team —

Quick note ahead of our quarter close: finance asked me to do a short coverage scan for Q3 bookings where we show a material delta to plan. I pulled a first-pass map (attached) and highlighted opportunities that are currently at risk because of stage lag or missing expected legal/PO milestones. Topline asks:

- Can you confirm which of these opportunities have an active legal/PO timeline this month? (column: PO_expected_date)
- If a PO isn't locked, please mark whether procurement approval is still in flight or if procurement requires a new quote.

I've cc'd Marissa and Laura from Rev Ops — they will coordinate any contract/discount exceptions if we need to surface to finance. Marcus, please note any forecast changes you expect for the mid-market book.

Attachments: [Attachment: ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 142KB)]

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales, Mid-Market

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the heads-up. Quick responses inline: 

- Opportunity ACME-243: PO expected by 09/25; procurement asked for a final quote revision (we expect sign-off).
- Opportunity ACME-259: Procurement put on hold pending budget re-org; no PO this quarter.
- Opportunity ACME-301: Sales/legal have verbal approval; PO draft being prepared.

I attached an updated map with PO_expected_date and a short note column. We flagged ACME-259 as a downside.

Great detail, Sarah — thanks. Two quick ops items from Rev Ops to keep finance comfortable:

1) Stage hygiene sweep: Marcus/Marcus's team — can you confirm stage gating on these three named opportunities by COB Monday (09/22)? We need updated stage, next milestone, and expected close probability in the tracker.
2) Commit refresh: Rishi — if ACME-243 is still on for 09/25, can you commit the booking at the mid-point (conservative) for our run-rate model? If not, highlight the conditional items (legal/discount/PO).

I've attached a cleaned commit_tracker.csv that matches the fields finance wants (opportunity, stage, next_milestone, PO_expected_date, committed_amount). Please append your notes before EOD Monday.

Attachment: [Attachment: commit_tracker.csv (csv, 12KB)]

- ACME-243: Rishi -> commit conservative $420k (mid-point) into the run-rate model. Legal expects PO 09/25; Sarah to send final PO scan.
- ACME-259: Marked as downside; we will mark 0 committed this quarter. Finance aware.
- ACME-301: Conditional commit of $110k (legal has verbal approval). Will convert to full commit once PO is received.
